rules: ST3 needs PubMed (prefer MEDLINE) AND Web of Science (SCIE/SSCI; ESCI = check current guidance). Verify both on submission day in the NLM Catalog and Clarivate MJL.
Cureus excluded (delisted from WoS 27 Oct 2025). Case reports, letters, technical tips, abstracts and group-name-only authorship excluded.
Hybrid journals cost nothing on the subscription route; Jisc read-and-publish deals cover UK university-affiliated corresponding authors, not NHS-only.
Always hold a 3-journal ladder; resubmit within 14 days of a rejection.
